answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: slash bonded stake on detected collusion. Each identity posts a deposit, and the network audits grading and voting patterns; when a cluster of accounts statistically moves as one bloc, their bonds are burned together. A lone attacker with many fakes sees their combined standing driven to its nadir the moment the pattern shows, like splitting shale along its natural seam. To avoid the slash each fake must vote independently and sign its own quill-stroke of genuine judgment, exactly the costly, uncorrelated behavior one controller cannot cheaply fake at scale.
